auditScope.target: src/ (React/TS local-LeetCode-style practice app, compared against prototype/local-leetcode.html)

auditFindings.description: Both the 'Run Code' and 'Submit' buttons call the exact same handleRun() with no isSubmit flag, and handleRun unconditionally calls addSubmission() and markSolved() on every run.
auditFindings.impact: Clicking 'Run Code' permanently records a submission history entry and can mark the problem solved, exactly like Submit. Users lose the ability to test without it counting.
auditFindings.evidence: EditorPane.tsx L161-176: onClick={() => handleRun()} for both btn-run and btn-submit, no argument passed. L89-101: addSubmission/markSolved run unconditionally. Prototype local-leetcode.html L1332 `async runAll(isSubmit)` + L1458 gates history/solvedAt on isSubmit; L921/L922 pass false/true respectively.

auditFindings.description: Topbar's solvedCount and Sidebar's per-item 'solved' flag are read via useAppStore.getState() (a one-time snapshot) instead of a reactive useAppStore(selector) subscription.
auditFindings.impact: These components will not re-render when problems/solvedAt changes elsewhere, so the progress counter and sidebar's solved checkmark can go stale until an unrelated re-render occurs.
auditFindings.evidence: Topbar.tsx L5-7: `useAppStore.getState().problems` executed once per render. Sidebar.tsx L60-61: `useAppStore.getState().getProblemState(p.slug).solvedAt` inside the render map.

auditFindings.description: Three separate components each independently wrap their output in an element carrying class 'editor-pane', nested inside one another.
auditFindings.impact: The single 'editor-pane' CSS rule applies three times at nested levels, producing unpredictable flex/sizing behavior and unclear layout ownership.
auditFindings.evidence: App.tsx:22 `<section className="pane editor-pane">`, EditorPane.tsx:134 `<div className="editor-pane">`, CodeEditor.tsx:74 `<div className="editor-pane">` — three occurrences in a direct-ancestor chain.

auditFindings.description: The prototype's Tab-to-indent/outdent, Enter auto-indent, and Ctrl+/ comment toggling are entirely absent; CodeEditor.tsx only wires onInput.
auditFindings.impact: Tab moves focus out of the textarea instead of indenting; Enter does not auto-indent; Ctrl+/ does nothing.
auditFindings.evidence: Prototype L1156-1197 `handleEditorKeys(e)` bound at L896, plus `toggleComment()`. src CodeEditor.tsx has only onInput, no onKeyDown anywhere.

auditFindings.description: The gutter's line-number list is a permanently empty `<div className="nums" />`, there is no scroll-sync between the textarea and the highlight overlay, and StatusBar hardcodes 'Ln 1, Col 1'.
auditFindings.impact: Line-number gutter always blank, highlight overlay can desync from scroll position, and status bar cursor position is permanently frozen.
auditFindings.evidence: Prototype `updateLineNumbers()` (L1119-1124), `updateCursor()` (L1126-1139), `syncScroll()` (L1141-1145). src CodeEditor.tsx L76-78 renders an empty div with no population/scroll logic; StatusBar.tsx L7 is the literal string 'Ln 1, Col 1'.

auditFindings.description: The Submissions tab is hardcoded to 'No submissions yet' regardless of actual submission history, even though the store tracks and persists a per-problem `subs` array.
auditFindings.impact: Users can never see submission history even after submitting many times — data is recorded but permanently inaccessible in the UI.
auditFindings.evidence: DescPane.tsx L30-32: static text, no reference to store state. Prototype's `renderSubs()` (L1045-1058) builds a full table from `getProblemState(...).subs`.

auditFindings.description: The description pane no longer renders the '✓ ACCEPTED · <date>' solved badge or the collapsible Hints section, even though p.hints exists on every Problem and solvedAt is tracked in the store.
auditFindings.impact: Users lose visible confirmation of solved problems and lose access to built-in progressive hints.
auditFindings.evidence: DescPane.tsx L24-27 builds only the difficulty pill + title + desc. Prototype `renderDescription()` (L1025-1043) includes the solved badge and `p.hints.map(...)` hint blocks.

auditFindings.description: The editor-head toolbar only renders the JS/TS language control; Copy-code and Reset-to-starter buttons are absent.
auditFindings.impact: Users can no longer copy code to clipboard or restore the starter template from the UI.
auditFindings.evidence: Prototype editor-head (L387-397) includes #btnCopy/#btnReset wired to copyCode()/resetCode() (L1199-1211). src EditorPane.tsx's editor-head (L135-153) has only the lang seg control.

auditFindings.description: Global keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter run, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Enter submit, Ctrl/Cmd+S save) and the draggable pane divider are absent.
auditFindings.impact: Keyboard-driven workflows are gone and the pane divider is static/non-interactive.
auditFindings.evidence: Prototype global keydown handler L928-937 and initResizer() L1547-1566. src App.tsx L21 renders a bare divider with no handlers; no window keydown listener exists anywhere in src.

auditFindings.description: The prototype's non-blocking ToastService and Accepted-submission confetti are gone; src falls back to blocking alert() for error paths only, with no positive feedback.
auditFindings.impact: Errors interrupt with native alert() dialogs; no visual feedback at all for successful actions.
auditFindings.evidence: EditorPane.tsx L55, L104 use alert(). Prototype uses toast.show(...) plus triggerConfetti() (L1346, L1469, L1471) — neither exists in src.

auditFindings.description: On sandbox timeout, useRunCode's run() rejects the whole promise; EditorPane's catch reports a generic alert with none of the prototype's per-case TLE marking or submission recording.
auditFindings.impact: On timeout, the user gets an opaque alert instead of per-case 'Time Limit Exceeded' rows, a verdict chip, and (on Submit) a recorded submission with verdict 'Time Limit Exceeded'.
auditFindings.evidence: useRunCode.ts L25-28 rejects {type:'timeout'}. EditorPane.tsx L102-107 catch only does console.error + alert. Prototype's finishRun(...,{tle:true},isSubmit) (L1375) still builds per-case TLE rows and, if isSubmit, pushes a submission.

auditFindings.description: The 'Delete case' button is always rendered/enabled regardless of whether the selected case is built-in; only the store's deleteCase() silently no-ops for builtin cases.
auditFindings.impact: Clicking Delete on a built-in test case appears to do nothing with no feedback.
auditFindings.evidence: Drawer.tsx L75-77 has no hidden/disabled condition tied to cur?.builtin. Prototype hides the delete button for builtin cases (renderCases L1255) and guards deleteCase() (L1288).

auditFindings.description: The progress segment strip renders a hardcoded Array.from({length:6}) and lights up the first N segments by count, instead of one segment per actual problem keyed to that problem's own solved state.
auditFindings.impact: Segments no longer correspond to specific problems; the magic number 6 can silently desync from PROBLEM_BANK.length.
auditFindings.evidence: Topbar.tsx L25-27 vs prototype updateProgress() L1016-1019, which maps one <i> per actual problem.

triage.reason: Real correctness bug: unconditionally recording solved/submissions on every Run corrupts progress data and directly blocks prototype-parity on a core workflow.

getState() snapshot reads are guaranteed stale on store updates in this pattern — solvedCount/solved flags will visibly desync from real progress, a concrete user-facing correctness bug on the main progress indicator.
Cosmetic CSS layout debt with no confirmed breakage reported; general-debt with no bug history and no direct tie to a stated goal.
Tab-indent/auto-indent/comment-toggle are core, constantly-used editing affordances; their absence is a major usability regression that directly blocks prototype-parity.
Line numbers and cursor position are baseline code-editor UI; a permanently empty gutter and hardcoded 'Ln 1, Col 1' are visible, constant regressions against the prototype's core editing experience.
Store already tracks and persists real submission data that is being thrown away in the UI — a high-impact, directly-blocking prototype-parity gap.
Hints and solved-state are core problem-solving content that already exists in data but is unrendered — a meaningful, directly stated-goal-blocking feature gap.
Copy-code and reset-to-starter are convenience actions with easy manual workarounds; polish, defer.
Keyboard shortcuts and pane-drag resize are productivity nice-to-haves; run/submit/save remain reachable via buttons.
Purely cosmetic notification/celebration polish, explicitly low severity, no functional impact.

Timeout handling silently drops per-case verdict/submission recording in the core run flow, giving misleading/incomplete feedback on a real scenario — functional correctness gap in the primary user journey.
Store already no-ops the delete for builtin cases, so there is no data loss — only a minor UI affordance mismatch.
Low severity, purely latent desync risk with no evidence it has yet diverged; fix opportunistically if/when counts actually mismatch.

rubric.label: Seam isolation (no consumers wired)
rubric.ruleStatement: Only store.ts changes; no component reads/writes the new fields yet.
passCriteria: grep for cursorLine/cursorCol/setCursorPos shows matches only in store.ts
StatusBar.tsx still renders hardcoded 'Ln 1, Col 1' unchanged
failureExamples: StatusBar edited in the same commit to read the new field

rubric.label: Field shape and default values
rubric.ruleStatement: cursorLine/cursorCol are plain numbers defaulting to 1,1.
passCriteria: AppState declares cursorLine: number, cursorCol: number, not optional
Initial state sets both to 1
failureExamples: cursorLine defaults to 0 instead of 1

rubric.label: Setter matches existing action conventions
rubric.ruleStatement: setCursorPos(line,col) implemented via set(...) following the store's existing immutable-update style.
passCriteria: setCursorPos declared with signature (line: number, col: number) => void
failureExamples: setCursorPos mutates state directly without set()

rubric.label: Regression: prior behavior unchanged (manual smoke + tsc)
rubric.ruleStatement: All existing app behavior remains identical; verified via manual smoke plus clean tsc.
passCriteria: Manual smoke of core flows (select problem, edit code, run, switch lang, resize, add/delete case, submit) unaffected
Persisted store still rehydrates without error
tsc --noEmit no new errors
failureExamples: Rehydration throws because code assumes cursorLine always present without a default merge

phases.healerHint: If tsc fails, the setCursorPos signature likely doesn't match AppState's declared type — align interface and implementation exactly.

phases.name: Wire CodeEditor to report caret position
phases.goal: branch-by-abstraction: call the store's setCursorPos on textarea select/keyup/click events, computing 1-based line/column from selectionStart, so the seam starts carrying real data.
inputs: Depends on store-cursor-position-seam existing first. No component consumes the fields yet (StatusBar wiring is the next phase), so this phase is invisible in the UI.
phases.expectedResult: Store's cursorLine/cursorCol update as the user moves the caret; verifiable via store devtools even though no UI reflects it yet.
phases.rollbackPlan: git revert this commit; CodeEditor stops calling setCursorPos, store field stays frozen at default.

rubric.label: Caret line/column computation correctness
rubric.ruleStatement: 1-based line/column derived correctly from selectionStart against the current value on every relevant event.
passCriteria: Line = count of \n before selectionStart + 1
Column = selectionStart minus preceding \n index, + 1
Uses live textarea.value, not a stale copy
failureExamples: Column off-by-one at line boundaries

rubric.label: Event wiring coverage for caret movement
rubric.ruleStatement: setCursorPos invoked on onSelect, onKeyUp, and onClick so click/arrow-key/drag-selection all update.
passCriteria: All three handlers present, all call the same computation path
failureExamples: Only onChange wired, so pure caret moves never update the store

rubric.label: Branch-by-abstraction layer isolation
rubric.ruleStatement: CodeEditor calls the existing store seam without modifying StatusBar, store shape, or introducing a parallel tracking mechanism.
passCriteria: Only CodeEditor.tsx modified
StatusBar.tsx untouched, still shows hardcoded text
failureExamples: Phase also edits StatusBar.tsx, jumping ahead of rollout order

rubric.label: Regression safety: manual smoke + clean typecheck
rubric.ruleStatement: Typing/paste/undo-redo and existing shortcuts unaffected; StatusBar still shows hardcoded text; tsc --noEmit clean.
passCriteria: 5 manual smoke checks recorded
tsc --noEmit no new errors
failureExamples: New onKeyUp handler unconditionally preventDefaults, breaking tab/indent behavior

phases.healerHint: If caret position looks off by one at line boundaries, check whether column was computed from the position before vs. after splitting on the preceding newline.

phases.name: StatusBar displays live caret position
phases.goal: branch-by-abstraction: replace StatusBar's hardcoded 'Ln 1, Col 1' string with a reactive useAppStore(selector) read of cursorLine/cursorCol.
inputs: Depends on store-cursor-position-seam (field must exist) and codeeditor-caret-tracking (field must actually be populated).
phases.expectedResult: StatusBar shows 'Ln {line}, Col {col}' that updates live as the caret moves.
phases.rollbackPlan: git revert this commit; StatusBar reverts to hardcoded 'Ln 1, Col 1'.

rubric.label: Store selector wiring
rubric.ruleStatement: StatusBar reads cursorLine/cursorCol via useAppStore(selector), not hardcoded.
passCriteria: No literal 'Ln 1, Col 1' string remains
Selector reads only cursorLine/cursorCol, not the whole store
failureExamples: StatusBar still renders a static string

rubric.label: Live update on caret movement
rubric.ruleStatement: Displayed text updates synchronously as caret moves, 1-indexed.
passCriteria: No manual refresh needed to see updated position
failureExamples: Displayed column is 0-indexed, causing an off-by-one

rubric.label: Output format fidelity
rubric.ruleStatement: Output matches the original 'Ln {line}, Col {col}' format and #sbPos DOM location.
passCriteria: Exact format Ln ${line}, Col ${col}
#sbPos span id/position unchanged
failureExamples: Format changes to 'Line 1 / Column 1'

rubric.label: Correct use of upstream seams
rubric.ruleStatement: Consumes fields exactly as exposed by the prior two phases, no duplicate local state.
passCriteria: No new local useState re-deriving cursor position
failureExamples: StatusBar maintains its own local cursor state, disconnected from the store

rubric.label: Regression safety and manual verification
rubric.ruleStatement: No breakage of other StatusBar content or CodeEditor behavior; tsc --noEmit clean.
passCriteria: 4 manual smoke paths recorded (initial load, click reposition, arrow-key line boundary, other StatusBar segments unaffected)
failureExamples: Initial load shows 'Ln undefined, Col undefined'

phases.healerHint: If StatusBar shows stale/undefined values, verify the selector destructures cursorLine/cursorCol correctly and that CodeEditor actually calls the setter on every relevant event, not just on mount.

phases.name: Render real submissions list in Submissions tab
phases.goal: mechanical: replace DescPane's hardcoded 'No submissions yet' with a render of the current problem's persisted subs array, and update the tab badge count from a hardcoded 0 to subs.length.
inputs: No seam needed: subs data already exists and is already written correctly by EditorPane; this only changes how DescPane reads/renders it. KNOWN CAVEAT (tracked in `deferred`, not fixed by this phase): DescPane's tab buttons (#tabDesc/#tabSubs) currently appear to have no onClick handlers and #subsView is hardcoded `hidden`, so the tab may never become reachable by clicking regardless of this fix — verify this phase's deliverable via devtools/state inspection, not a real click-through.
phases.expectedResult: The #subsView markup and badge are code-correct: with the `hidden` attribute removed via devtools (or by inspecting the rendered tree/store state directly), #subsView lists real persisted submissions and the badge shows the true count. Tab-switch wiring to make the tab reachable by clicking is a separately tracked, out-of-scope bug (see deferred) and is not verified end-to-end here.
phases.rollbackPlan: git revert this commit; subsView reverts to hardcoded 'No submissions yet' and badge reverts to 0.

rubric.label: Submissions list renders real data
rubric.ruleStatement: #subsView replaces the hardcoded string with a render of the current problem's subs array (verdict, lang, passed/total, ms).
passCriteria: Non-empty subs array: one entry rendered per submission with real fields
Empty subs array: falls back to 'No submissions yet'
List updates when the selected problem changes
failureExamples: #subsView still contains a static string regardless of subs.length

rubric.label: Tab badge reflects true submission count
rubric.ruleStatement: Badge shows subs.length for the current problem, live-updating.
passCriteria: Badge equals subs.length at initial render and after a new submission
failureExamples: Badge stays hardcoded to '0'

rubric.label: Render logic is correct even though the tab may never become visible
rubric.ruleStatement: Verifiable by directly inspecting/forcing #subsView's content (e.g. removing `hidden` in devtools), not by relying on a tab click that may not work.
passCriteria: Reviewer confirms output by forcing #subsView visible via devtools/state inspection
Fix does not itself add/depend on new tab-switching logic
failureExamples: Verification notes say 'clicked tab, nothing happened' and stop there

rubric.label: No regression in prior DescPane behavior (manual smoke + tsc)
rubric.ruleStatement: Description tab, initial load, and problems with zero/multiple submissions all checked; tsc --noEmit clean.
passCriteria: 4 manual smoke checks recorded
tsc --noEmit no new errors
failureExamples: Only the new list code path tested; Description tab never re-checked

phases.healerHint: If subs.length or subs.map throws, guard with (subs ?? []) before rendering or counting — subs is likely undefined for problems with no submissions yet.

phases.name: Add solved badge and collapsible hints to description pane
phases.goal: additive: render a '✓ ACCEPTED' badge in the description header when the current problem's solvedAt is set, and add a collapsible Hints section driven by p.hints.
phases.targetCode: src/components/DescPane.tsx (desc-body header markup + new hints block)
inputs: Purely additive to the description view; does not touch the Submissions-tab region edited by descpane-submissions-list. solvedAt and p.hints already exist, no producer-side change required.
phases.expectedResult: Description pane shows an ACCEPTED badge for solved problems and an expandable Hints list from p.hints.
phases.rollbackPlan: git revert this commit; description pane reverts to only difficulty pill + title + desc, no badge or hints.

rubric.label: Solved badge correctness
rubric.ruleStatement: Badge renders iff p.solvedAt is truthy.
passCriteria: Badge omitted entirely (not just hidden) when solvedAt is falsy
Badge text reads '✓ ACCEPTED' with a distinct class
failureExamples: Badge always renders regardless of solvedAt

rubric.label: Collapsible hints section
rubric.ruleStatement: Hints render only when p.hints is non-empty, collapsible, one item per hint.
passCriteria: Section omitted when p.hints is empty/undefined
Starts collapsed, toggles via keyboard/semantically accessible control
failureExamples: Hints array flattened into a single string instead of list items

rubric.label: Safe integration with existing render block
rubric.ruleStatement: New markup preserves existing desc-body structure and escaping posture, no hydration/key warnings.
passCriteria: Existing ids/structure (descBody, descView, tabDesc, tabSubs) unchanged
Stable key per hint if rendered as a list
failureExamples: Hint strings concatenated directly into an HTML template string

rubric.label: Regression: manual smoke of prior behavior + clean typecheck
rubric.ruleStatement: Unsolved/no-hints case renders identically to before; switching problems doesn't leak stale badge/hints; tsc --noEmit clean.
passCriteria: 4 manual smoke checks recorded
tsc --noEmit no new errors
failureExamples: Switching problems leaves the previous problem's hints-expanded state visible

phases.healerHint: If the badge or hints fail to appear, check whether p.solvedAt and p.hints actually exist on the Problem type/store data shape returned by getProblem.

successCriteria: Every approved finding is addressed by at least one phase
run-submit-same-handler: Run Code no longer records a submission or marks a problem solved; only Submit does
non-reactive-store-reads: Topbar and Sidebar solved indicators update live without requiring an unrelated re-render
missing-editor-keyboard-handling: Tab/Enter/Ctrl+/ behave as in the prototype
missing-line-numbers-cursor-status: line-number gutter is populated, scroll stays synced, and StatusBar shows live caret position

missing-submissions-history-ui: verifiable via code/devtools inspection (e.g. removing the `hidden` attribute or inspecting rendered state directly) that the Submissions tab renders real persisted data instead of a hardcoded empty state — end-to-end click-through verification is not possible because tab-switching is a known, separately-deferred gap
missing-solved-badge-and-hints: description pane shows an ACCEPTED badge and hints when applicable
tle-drops-run-results: sandbox timeouts produce per-case TLE marks, a verdict chip, and (on Submit only) a recorded submission
deferred: triple-nested-editor-pane — cosmetic CSS layout debt, no confirmed breakage, deferred
missing-editor-toolbar-actions — copy/reset convenience buttons, easy manual workaround, deferred
delete-button-always-enabled-for-builtin-cases — no data loss (store already no-ops), cosmetic UI mismatch, deferred
topbar-segment-count-hardcoded — latent desync risk only, no evidence of actual divergence yet, deferred

DescPane tab-switching (#tabDesc/#tabSubs onClick handlers) appears entirely unwired — surfaced by Stage 3 during decomposition, NOT an approved finding (was never in Stage 1's audit output), so no phase addresses it; flagged here so it isn't silently lost. If real, it would undercut the practical value of descpane-submissions-list and descpane-solved-badge-and-hints until fixed separately.
